summary: Iteration 17 — Full admin panel + Pinball webhook + Netlify import end-to-end testing on the live preview URL. Found and FIXED one critical backend bug: load_dotenv() ran AFTER `from admin_routes import register_admin_routes`, causing admin_routes to read PINBALL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN as empty string at module-load time, which made every webhook (even with the correct token) return 401. After moving load_dotenv() above the import in /app/backend/server.py, all 12 module pytests pass, all 18 live integration pytests pass, all admin frontend flows verified.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED in this iteration: /app/backend/server.py had `from admin_routes import register_admin_routes` on line 47 BEFORE `load_dotenv()` on line 52. admin_routes.py line 29 reads PINBALL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN at module import time, so it was always empty in the running server (only the pytest suite worked because it sets os.environ before importing and then importlib.reload(admin_routes)). Moved load_dotenv() up so it runs before the admin_routes import. Smoke test confirms the webhook now responds 200 with status=ok using the production .env token 'replace-me-before-deploy'.

(Optional hardening) admin_routes.py could read PINBALL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN lazily inside the request handler (`os.environ.get('PINBALL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN')` per-call) — that would have prevented the bug entirely and lets ops rotate the token without restarting uvicorn. Module-level constant is a foot-gun for env-driven secrets.
(Carried from prev iterations) Studio.jsx is 1274 lines and server.py is ~2442 lines — refactor recommended.

Admin.jsx + BuyersTab.jsx + ActivityTab.jsx + StatsTab.jsx are clean, well-scoped, use api client + toasts consistently, and all critical interactive elements have data-testid attributes — solid implementation.

rca of the issue: Root cause: env-load-order bug. /app/backend/server.py imported admin_routes BEFORE calling load_dotenv(). Since admin_routes.py reads PINBALL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN via os.environ.get(...) at module top-level (line 29), the constant was '' (empty) in the running uvicorn process because /app/backend/.env hadn't been loaded yet. The token-gate `if not PINBALL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN or token != PINBALL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN:` then rejected every request as 'invalid token'. The pytest suite masked this because it explicitly sets os.environ['PINBALL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN']='test-token-xyz' and then importlib.reload(admin_routes) BEFORE importing server — so it picked up the env. Reproduction: POST /api/pinball-webhook?token=replace-me-before-deploy&product=base with any body → 401 Unauthorized. Fix: moved `load_dotenv()` above the `from admin_routes import register_admin_routes` line in server.py. Verified with curl and 18-test live pytest suite (all pass).
